logger.doc:name: Log Fetch Start
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Fetching company file data from MDM | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId]

logger.doc:name: Log Transform Start
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Transforming data | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Records: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.data default [])]

logger.doc:name: Log ADLS Write Start
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Writing data to ADLS | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Records: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.records default [])]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "SUCCESS", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "timestamp": now(), "processingTime": ((now() - vars.processStartTime) as Number) ++ "ms", "recordsProcessed": sizeOf(vars.transformedData.records default []), "recordsFetched": sizeOf(vars.mdmData.data default []), "recordsWritten": payload.recordsWritten default sizeOf(vars.transformedData.records default []), "adlsFileName": payload.fileName default null }

logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Process completed successfully | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Records: ' ++ payload.recordsProcessed]

logger.doc:name: Log MDM Response
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] MDM data fetched | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Records: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.data default [])]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "metadata": { "sourceSystem": "MDM", "destinationSystem": "ADLS", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "processedTimestamp": now(), "recordCount": sizeOf(payload.data default []), "businessCriticality": "Financial", "serviceTier": "Maintenance" }, "records": (payload.data default []) map { "companyId": $.companyId default null, "companyName": $.companyName default null, "companyCode": $.companyCode default null, "registrationNumber": $.registrationNumber default null, "taxIdentifier": $.taxIdentifier default null, "incorporationDate": $.incorporationDate default null, "industry": $.industry default null, "country": $.country default null, "region": $.region default null, "status": $.status default "ACTIVE", "financialData": { "currency": $.financialData.currency default null, "fiscalYearEnd": $.financialData.fiscalYearEnd default null, "accountingStandard": $.financialData.accountingStandard default null }, "contactInfo": { "address": $.contactInfo.address default null, "city": $.contactInfo.city default null, "postalCode": $.contactInfo.postalCode default null, "phone": $.contactInfo.phone default null, "email": $.contactInfo.email default null }, "metadata": { "createdDate": $.metadata.createdDate default now(), "modifiedDate": $.metadata.modifiedDate default now(), "createdBy": $.metadata.createdBy default "SYSTEM", "modifiedBy": $.metadata.modifiedBy default "SYSTEM" }, "auditInfo": { "syncTimestamp": now(), "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "sourceSystem": "MDM", "processedBy": p('api.process.name') } } }

logger.doc:name: Log Transform Complete
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Data transformation completed | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Transformed Records: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.records default [])]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "fileName": p('adls.fileNamePattern') replace "{timestamp}" with (now() as String {format: "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"}), "containerName": p('adls.containerName'), "directory": p('adls.directory'), "data": payload }

logger.doc:name: Log ADLS Write Complete
logger.message: #['[PROCESS] Data written to ADLS | CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Response: ' ++ payload]
